label: Planned fertility
definition: Births framed as subject to deliberate control: spacing, limiting, stopping, or timing
example: Condoms and self control. We've been married 5 years and have just 1 child. As planned.

label: Modern contraception / medical authority
definition: Names a modern contraceptive method or invokes doctors, clinics, or health authorities
example: we went to d hospital, they gave us a booklet, I went home n compared my options. I went for implanon. they are all free, here in abuja general hospitals.

label: Female reproductive autonomy
definition: Asserts a woman's right or capacity to decide her own childbearing
example: For goodness sake, it's her body! Every pregnancy comes with it's own risks and at the end of the day, it's up to the woman (and no one else) to take care of her body.
